creator: Claude Code (claude-sonnet-5-5) worker session tien-nghich-2d-29, 2026-11-22
method: create_character_pro_flash (32x32 native, low top-down, cat template, 8 views, 40-colour palette, seed 7) then animate_character v3 per direction. All four facings are separate PixelLab generations; nothing is mirrored.
prompt: Small hare, slender rabbit-like animal standing on all four legs, soft blue-grey fur, cream belly, two very long upright ears. The LEFT ear has a bright pale-yellow star-glint tip, clearly visible as a bright dot at the top of that ear; the RIGHT ear is plain grey with a dark tip. Short round tail. 3/4 top-down, chunky pixel art, 1px dark outline, light from top-left.

idle.action_description: stands still breathing gently, the long ears twitch slightly, nose wiggles; the single bright yellow glint stays at the tip of the one marked ear

direction_prompts.south: facing the viewer, breathes gently, ears twitch; the bright yellow glint stays at the tip of the ear on the viewer's left
direction_prompts.west: facing left, breathes gently, ears twitch; the bright yellow glint stays at the tip of the ear
direction_prompts.north: seen from behind, breathes gently, ears twitch; the bright yellow glint stays at the tip of the ear on the viewer's right
direction_prompts.east: facing right, breathes gently, ears twitch; the bright yellow glint stays at the tip of the ear

west.prompt: facing left, breathes gently, ears twitch; a bright yellow glint dot stays clearly visible at the tip of the nearer ear in EVERY frame, the ear tip is never dark (second attempt, west only)

follow.action_description: hops forward in a quick bounding hop cycle, ears streaming back; the single bright yellow glint stays at the tip of the one marked ear

direction_prompts.south: hops toward the viewer in a compact narrow hop, staying within a narrow column; the bright yellow glint stays at the tip of the ear on the viewer's left
direction_prompts.west: hops to the left, ears streaming back to the right; the bright yellow glint stays at the tip of the ear
direction_prompts.north: hops away from the viewer, seen from behind, compact narrow hop; the bright yellow glint stays at the tip of the ear on the viewer's right
direction_prompts.east: hops to the right, ears streaming back to the left; the bright yellow glint stays at the tip of the ear

west.prompt: hops to the left, ears streaming back to the right; a bright yellow glint dot stays clearly visible at the tip of the nearer ear in EVERY frame, the ear tip is never dark (second attempt, west only)

attempts.what: character (seed 7) then idle and follow v3, four directions each (follow east appended to the follow group because only 3 job slots were free)
idle west and follow west regenerated once each with an emphasised ear-tip prompt (the first west clips showed a thin, partly dark tip)
attempts.result: rejected: idle west no better than the first take; follow west worse (tip floats off the ear in frame 3, ear shape distorted). The first west clips were kept. The regenerated frames are only in the PixelLab account, not shipped.

known_flaws: the bright ear tip is small (1-3 px) and shifts between pale yellow and cream between frames; in west it is the thinnest
the cat template stands the hare upright in south and north, so it reads as a sitting-up hare rather than a four-legged crouch
